stories.title: NZ vs IND 1st Test: Rishabh Pant's century put India in command after Day 4
stories.summary: Wellington: A dominant batting display from KL Rahul, Shubman Gill and Rishabh Pant put India firmly in control of the first Test against New Zealand as the visitors reached 486/4 at stumps on Day 3 at the Basin Reserve in Wellington on Saturday.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant becomes first Asian wicketkeeper to score century in all SENA countries
stories.summary: India's Rishabh Pant scripted history on Sunday with his latest century in the Wellington Test against New Zealand. After bringing up his ninth Test ton off just 135 deliveries on Day 4 of the first Test at the Basin Reserve, Pant became the first Asian wicketkeeper to score a century in all SENA (South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia) countries.

stories.title: ‘Showing off for Selena Gomez’ - Wembanyama hits 50 points in Spurs win
stories.summary: San Antonio Spurs star Victor Wembanyama hit 50 points in a historic performance as his side beat the New Orleans Pelicans 114-91. The 22-year-old, who is 7ft 4ins tall, became the first player with 50 points, five blocks and five three-pointers in a match since the NBA added threes in 1979–80.

stories.title: Alcaraz to face Zverev in ATP Finals title decider
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz will face world number one Alexander Zverev for the ATP Finals title after completing a superb comeback victory against Ben Shelton. The indomitable Spaniard recovered from a flat start to outlast Shelton 3-6 6-3 7-6 (7-1) and secure a return to the showpiece, 12 months after losing to Jannik Sinner.

stories.title: Fox Cricket takes David Warner, Usman Khawaja off air as Sandpapergate row deepens
stories.summary: The Sandpapergate is creating new divisions in Australian cricket, eight years after the ball-tampering scandal erupted on the Test tour to South Africa. Now, Fox Cricket has temporarily taken David Warner and Usman Khawaja off the air. The duo will be rested from commentary in the next few weeks as fresh allegations and counterclaims surface around the 2018 ball-tampering incident.

stories.title: Rishabh Pant creates history! India star climbs to all-time No. 2 in Test cricket
stories.summary: The India wicketkeeper-batter now has 108 sixes in the longest format, moving past former New Zealand captain Brendon McCullum, who finished his Test career with 107 sixes. Pant achieved the milestone during his entertaining 128 off 153 balls at the Basin Reserve in Wellington. The 28-year-old was particularly aggressive against Glenn Phillips, completing his century with a straight six before sending another delivery over extra cover.

stories.title: Jacob Duffy enters unwanted record books after India's batting carnage
stories.summary: Duffy finished with figures of 1/201 as India piled up a mammoth 720/9 before declaring on the fourth day. The Indian batting line-up produced a collective effort, with KL Rahul leading the charge with 136. He shared century partnerships with Yashasvi Jaiswal, who scored 85, and Devdutt Padikkal, who made 80.

stories.title: Pat Cummins wins Cricket Australia's ‘unanimous support’ to remain Test captain
stories.summary: Cricket Australia threw its "unanimous support" behind Pat Cummins to remain Test captain on Saturday (November 21, 2026), rejecting any suggestion his integrity had been compromised by the lingering "Sandpapergate" scandal. Cummins has been under huge pressure since Usman Khawaja claimed the whole team knew about the plot to alter the ball in a Test at Cape Town in 2018.

stories.title: 35 lead changes, 352 overtakes, Verstappen's win: Las Vegas GP delivers craziest race
stories.summary: In a breathtaking display of speed and strategy, Max Verstappen triumphed at the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, navigating a challenging 50-lap race filled with 35 lead changes. Oscar Piastri, who impressively surged from 17th to finish third, marked a notable achievement for McLaren. stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony

stories.title: What does EPFO’s Systematic Withdrawal Plan entail for retirees | Explained
